title: Area formula, multiplicity and weighted forms (Simon 2.3.4, 2.3.5, erratum dHⁿ)
statement: For n ≤ m, A ⊆ ℝⁿ Lebesgue-null-measurable and f : ℝⁿ → ℝᵐ K-Lipschitz on A, with Jf(x) = √det(L*L), L = fderivWithin ℝ f A x: (3.4, corrected) ∫_{ℝᵐ} #(A ∩ f⁻¹{y}) dHⁿ(y) = ∫_A Jf dLⁿ; (3.5) for every h : ℝⁿ → [0,∞] a.e.-measurable on A, y ↦ Σ_{x ∈ A ∩ f⁻¹{y}} h(x) is Hⁿ-a.e.-measurable and its Hⁿ-integral equals ∫_A h Jf dLⁿ (Hⁿ = μHE[n]).
